title: Hardly Optimized
description: Hardly Optimized improves your game’s performance using essential optimization mods. These mods are carefully chosen to be safe for your worlds while delivering smoother gameplay and better FPS on most devices.
body:
~~By using this modpack, you agree to the following disclaimers.~~

**Performance**

Hardly Optimized improves your game’s performance using essential optimization mods. These mods are carefully chosen to be safe for your worlds while delivering smoother gameplay and better FPS on most devices.

**Lightweight Optimization**

This modpack focuses only on the basics—no extra features or unnecessary additions. It provides a simple and clean experience aimed purely at improving performance.

**Familiar Experience**

Hardly Optimized keeps the original Minecraft feel intact. You can enjoy the game just as you remember it, without major changes to gameplay or visuals.

**Works Everywhere**

Since there are no content mods included, you can use this pack on any world or server that supports vanilla clients.

**Easy to Update**

The modpack is easy to maintain and update, with minimal impact on your existing settings whenever possible.

**Built on Fabric**

Hardly Optimized uses the Fabric mod loader, known for being lightweight, fast, and widely supported.

**Simple and Clean**

Designed for players who just want better performance without extra complexity.
